summary: T1-02 round 2 passes. The codex-r1-1 blocker is fixed: declared nodata keeps its exact value, and long double arrays are refused on every platform. The claude-r1-1 rebuttal holds. Both story checks pass. Only quality.py and test_quality.py changed, and neither contains Stokes, CPR or S4-sign logic. I did not re-verify that the tests were written failing first, and I did not look at config/run.yaml. I did not read the full test file.

checks.evidence: ruff check, ruff format --check and mypy all clean. No failure or exit code shown.

checks.criterion: Tests are written and run failing first, on small synthetic numpy arrays only
checks.evidence: The tests use synthetic arrays only. I did not re-run the failing-first step. The log shows a test-first commit (d57fac2 before c94c693).

checks.criterion: Mask function returns valid bool array plus integer reason array. Enum has nodata, non_finite, outside_support. ISIS null is matched by a documented tolerance. Missing is never replaced by 0, and no threshold reason exists.
checks.evidence: quality.py:98-105 defines the enum. quality.py:94 gives the tolerance as half a float32 spacing (2**103). quality.py:364-374 builds a uint8 reason array and a bool valid array from it, and nothing modifies the values. A value of 0 stays valid unless declared as nodata. No threshold reason is defined, and the docstring at lines 46-47 notes radar.snr_rule is null.

checks.criterion: No Stokes, SC/OC/CPR or S4-sign logic in quality.py
checks.evidence: Those names appear only in the docstring, quality.py:30-31 and 49-52, pointing to polarimetry.py. The code has no such logic.

checks.criterion: Valid-fraction helper returns the covered fraction and counts, and raises on an empty window
checks.evidence: quality.py:188-207 raises ValueError when valid.size == 0. ValidFraction (159-185) carries valid_pixels, total_pixels and fraction.

_exact_value and _matches_declared (quality.py:226-296) keep the declared value as an exact Fraction. Integer arrays compare the exact integer. Floating arrays accept only a value that is exactly a double. Long double and complex long double arrays raise TypeError at quality.py:342. Regression tests are at test_quality.py:358-405.

checks.criterion: Paths limited to the story's files list
checks.evidence: Only quality.py and test_quality.py changed, outside the excluded ralph, reviews and logs paths.

findings.claim: The ISIS_SATURATION code is a fourth reason beyond the three the story names. The author's rebuttal is accepted.
findings.evidence: It matches exact ISIS special-pixel bit patterns and uses no threshold. The enum is documented and pinned by test_reason_codes_are_fixed, per the author's account. I did not read that test. Downstream stories must adopt this vocabulary.

resolution.reason: Not a defect, and the reviewer accepts the round-1 rebuttal (claude-r1-1). ISIS_SATURATION is an exact match on the four ISIS 4-byte special-pixel bit patterns (Lrs, Lis, His, Hrs from SpecialPixel.h), not a threshold, so the story rule against threshold reasons holds. PRD 7 (Validity rules) keeps three states distinct (missing observation, invalid measurement, valid low CPR), so saturated values cannot be folded into nodata. The story requires values near -3.4e38 to be invalid, and without the code they would pass as valid numbers. The test the reviewer did not read, pipeline/tests/test_quality.py:74-81 (test_reason_codes_are_fixed), pins the enum to VALID 0, NODATA 1, NON_FINITE 2, OUTSIDE_SUPPORT 3, ISIS_SATURATION 4. test_every_reason_code_is_documented_in_the_module (:84-89) requires each label in the module docstring. On downstream adoption, grep finds no other user of InvalidReason in pipeline/ or packages/. T1-04 to T1-06 will call quality.py, and the progress log tells them to report reasons with InvalidReason.label, so there is one vocabulary. Checks run again: uv run pytest pipeline/tests/test_quality.py (92 passed, exit 0); make check (exit 0).
